name: Palladous-Esker

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near impact-scarred wastelands that no expedition has ever claimed.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Regular pulses leave the buried megastructure aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
